name: Daylight
summary: Sunlight fills a 60-foot-radius Sphere (Bright Light, plus 60 ft. Dim Light) for 1 hour.
text: For 1 hour, sunlight spreads from a point within 60 feet and fills a 60-foot-radius Sphere. The area is Bright Light, and Dim Light extends 60 feet beyond it. Instead, you can cast the spell on an object that nobody is wearing or carrying; the sunlight then fills a 60-foot Emanation from that object, and covering the object with something opaque, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the light. If any part of this spell's area overlaps an area of Darkness created by a spell of level 3 or lower, that other spell is dispelled.
